text:
jordan (acme): Hey team — we just started getting 403s when calling embeddings + rerank in a single pipeline. Worked yesterday. Example curl: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_XXXX' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"how to reset password","candidates":["a","b"],"embeddings_model":"rwd-embed-1"}'``` Response: `403 Forbidden {\"error\":\"insufficient_scope\",\"missing\":[\"embeddings:generate\",\"rerank:score\"]}`. Ticket CS-4821 created. Any ideas?

maria-support: sorry you're hitting that — looking. Can you confirm if this key was created via SSO provisioning or manually in Console? Also any chance the key was rotated?

jordan (acme): It's a machine user key we created via our org's SSO app last month. No rotation on our side. We did rotate app creds yesterday but didn't touch Redwood.

alex-cs: @maria-support I'll take first triage. Quick check: can you paste the exact request payload (no PII) and full response headers? The missing scopes in the body are suspicious — usually happens when token created without combined scopes.

jordan (acme): pasted sanitized payload above. Full response headers: ```HTTP/1.1 403 Forbidden
content-type: application/json
www-authenticate: Bearer realm=\"redwood\"
``` Body as above.

sophia-ml: I can repro locally by creating a scoped key that only has embeddings:read and not rerank:call and hitting the rerank endpoint — we return 403 with the missing scopes list. But two things to confirm: 1) is the customer calling a merged endpoint that does embeddings + rerank internally? 2) did SSO provisioning create a key template with limited scopes?

maria-support: jordan — can you check the Console > API keys page and click into the key to show scopes assigned? If you can't paste screenshot, just list the scope names.

jordan (acme): Console shows: ["embeddings:read", "inference:generate"] — no rerank. Huh. I thought rerank was included under embeddings.

chris-eng: this is a common confusion. rerank is its own permission (rerank:score or rerank:call depending on API). When keys are generated by SSO provisioning templates, some orgs only include embeddings+inference by default.

sophia-ml: repro steps I used: created key with scopes {"embeddings:read","inference:generate"} then call combined rerank endpoint that internally does embeddings + scoring. Server returns 403 and body includes missing rerank scope. Example quick repro curl: ```bash
KEY=sk_test_partial
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"query":"q","candidates":["a","b"]}' | jq .
# -> {"error":"insufficient_scope","missing":["rerank:score"]}
```

maria-support: thanks. Jordan — easiest immediate fix is to create a new key with the additional scope and test. Steps: Console -> API keys -> Create key -> check boxes for embeddings:generate (or read), inference:generate, and rerank:score (or rerank:call). Then update your app to use the new key.

jordan (acme): can we add the scope to the existing key instead of rotating? Our pipeline references the key id in multiple places.

alex-cs: we don't currently support retroactive scope editing on existing keys for security/audit reasons. Must create a new key. You can create a new key and add it alongside the old one then do a controlled swap.

jordan (acme): OK doing that now. Curious — why is the error not more explicit in the Console or SDK? The body is helpful but our SSO template should have included rerank.

chris-eng: internal note: SSO provisioning templates are managed by platform-auth team; some templates intentionally restrict rerank because it's a higher-cost operation. But we should make that explicit in the template UI. Filing follow-up.

sophia-ml: I'll also add a small change to the rerank handler to include a link in the 403 to the Console docs and the exact scope names to request. Small UX win.

deploy-bot: deploy triggered by chris-eng:feature/403-help-link — build 8302 -> canary -> prod. ETA ~10m :rocket:

maria-support: Jordan — once you create new key, can you test and paste the success snippet? We'll keep the CS ticket open until confirmed.

jordan (acme): created new key sk_live_full. Test curl now: ```curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/rerank -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk_live_full' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"query":"how to reset password","candidates":["a","b"],"embeddings_model":"rwd-embed-1"}'``` Response: `200 OK` payload with scores. Nice.

maria-support: great — marking CS-4821 resolved pending docs follow-up. Quick postmortem items: 1) educate SSO template owners to include rerank when customers opt-in, 2) Console UX note to show missing scope hints, 3) backend 403 link to docs (deployed).

alex-cs: logging action items in the customer-success board and tagging product: CS-4821 -> followups: ["SSO template docs","Console scope hint","SDK error surfacing"].

chris-eng: one more internal note — we should also add an automated check in the provisioning flow: if template includes embeddings and inference but not rerank, show a tooltip: "Rerank requires explicit rerank scope; costs may be higher."

sophia-ml: agreed. Also leaving a quick repro test in our regression suite so this doesn't silently reappear.

maria-support: Jordan — thanks for quick turnaround. Closing slack thread; ticket will remain open for the product followups. :white_check_mark:

jordan (acme): thanks all, appreciate the fast help :clap:
